en.title: Members Lacking Provider Network Access
en.description:
If any required specialty of a member has no provider within the maximum Euclidean distance, report that member.

The standard input/output format and supplementary bounds on this site are as defined in this problem statement.
en.input: The first line contains the provider count P, the member count M (both ≤1000), and the integer maxDistance (≤10^9); then P lines `providerId specialty x y` follow, and then M lines `memberId x y specialty|specialty...`. Coordinates and ID values are integers, and a specialty contains no spaces; memberId is unique, and each member requires ≤10 specialty values in total.
en.output: Output the memberId of every member who cannot get adequate network access, in ascending order, one per line; output nothing if there are none.
en.explanation: Build a coordinate index of provider entries by specialty. For each member, check every required specialty for a provider whose squared distance does not exceed d². The time is O(P+M·R·P_s), where P_s is the number of provider entries for the relevant specialty.
hints: Build a coordinate index of provider entries by specialty. For each member, check every required specialty for a provider whose squared distance does not exceed d². The time is O(P+M·R·P_s), where P_s is the number of provider entries for the relevant specialty.
